chart_tooltips.map: Shows the geographic distribution of residential electricity rate for the selected cut. Use it as spatial context after you identify the highest or lowest utilities in the ranking.
chart_tooltips.rank: Shows the utilities with the highest residential electricity rate in June 2026. Use it to identify the first utilities that deserve local follow-up.
chart_tooltips.trend: Shows the national average electricity rate and average blended generation rate over time from January 2020 through April 2026.

welcome_modal.definition: PRESYO-PH means Power Rates and Energy Supply Overview - Philippines.
welcome_modal.description: PRESYO brings Philippine electricity rate, utility, supplier, and source-evidence data into one briefing-friendly monitoring tool.
welcome_modal.owner: Developed and maintained by the Institute for Climate and Sustainable Cities (ICSC).
paragraphs: It aims to improve transparency on electricity rates across the Philippines.
By providing accessible data on generation rates and energy sources, it helps consumers, researchers, and decision-makers make more informed choices about electricity use and supply.
PRESYO-PH is designed as a public-interest monitoring and briefing tool.
welcome_modal.title: What is PRESYO?
